text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
"—Well then, that is all for today's menu. 
Thank you very much."
choice_data_list: Thank you for your hard work.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
We exchange our usual bow. With the Queen 
Elizabeth II Cup drawing near, 
preparations were proceeding smoothly.
choice_data_list:
Calling it a day without any extra 
training?

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Yes, that's the plan. It will be a quick 
turnaround right after the Shuka Sho, 
after all.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Just as you keep my daily menu on the 
lighter side, I believe my independent 
training should also focus primarily on 
conserving energy—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
âIn that instant, a sudden buzz and a 
strange presence began to drift through 
the air.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Alongside Air Messiah, whose ears stood on 
alert, we surveyed our surroundings 
without a clue what was happening, when—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Murmur, murmur, murmur, murmur...!!)

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Wh... What is this? Why has everyone 
gathered here like this...?
choice_data_list:
Is everyone... looking towards the 
track...?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Hurryyy uuup!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Geez, you guys! You can't just dilly-dally 
around!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Right now, this very second! I just want 
to run with all my might!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...And then, standing at the center of the 
immense roar of the crowd, the tiny girl 
declared in a clear, resonant voice.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Come on, all of you, bring it on together!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: I'll sweep 'em all away with my magic!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... Right, Sweep-san...? Are you really 
saying that in front of that lineup!?

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Ahahahahaha! Well now, that's quite the 
cute invitation!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: Alright! Let's dance, Little Witch!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
W-Wah... me too. If it's a match, I 
accept.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Oh wow... Tap-san was last year's Grand 
Prix Umamusume, right...?!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
That's right, the champion of the 
Takarazuka Kinen! And Zenno Rob Roy is an 
Autumn Senior Triple Crown Umamusume! On 
top of that—

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I too... would be honored to face you 
solemnly.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... Fufu, fufufu...!! ...Ah, no, bad 
girl... I must keep my beastly cravings... 
under control—

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
The second Triple Tiara winner in 
history...! Even Still in Love is here?! 
W-What kind of mock race is this...?! No 
way!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
I mean, haven't we barely seen Sweep at 
the training grounds lately anyway? I 
heard she was saying she just wasn't in 
the mood...

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Wait, so you just show up today out of 
nowhere and suddenly make this group run a 
mock race!? ...Isn't that way too 
wild~~~!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...An abruptly started, extraordinarily 
high-level mock race. Amidst the unsettled 
murmurs, the moment of the start arrived—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Right afterward.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Everyone had just witnessed "magic."

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: GO GO GOOOO! HAAAAAAAH!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
At 2,200 meters, coming around the fourth 
corner, Tap Dance City is the first to 
take the lead! Just as it looked like 
she'd hold on all the way to the wire—

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: —Taaaah!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Zenno Rob Roy has closed the gap all at 
once. Still in Love is also steadily 
pushing forward from behind, aiming for 
the lead.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: However...

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: ...Twinkle, twinkle.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Out of my way!! Haaaaaaaaaaaaah!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A formidable burst of final stretch speed 
flashes like lightning! Sweeping past all 
rivals from the outside—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...She crossed the finish line still 
holding the lead.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A short while after that shocking mock 
race.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Today, on the very turf of the Queen 
Elizabeth II Cup, we will face Sweep 
Tosho.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
...Ms. Sweep also managed to place on the 
board in the recent Tenno Sho (Autumn).

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Between that and the recent mock race, she 
has... already completely broken out of 
the mold of a Tiara Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Without a doubt, she is one of the 
Umamusume who defines this era.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu. Plus, that wild unpredictability 
of hers. In a way... she's the polar 
opposite of us, isn't she?

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Yes. ...That is precisely why there is 
great meaning in competing.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
"Everything I am right now. Everything 
I've built up, I shall unleash it all 
against Sweep-san."

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
(Yes... if I can demonstrate the strength 
passed down to me in this race against 
Sweep-san.)

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
(If I can defeat even her through a steady 
and solid accumulation of effort... that 
would be the most solid proof of all.)

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: (...However—)

text_block_list.name: Messiah's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Take your time. Try thinking it over with 
your Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Messiah's Mother
text_block_list.text:
"Not about 'your path as a daughter.' 
About 'your own path.'"

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
(...No, think later! Focus on the race 
right now—)

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Oh, my! If it isn't Messiah!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
You won the Shuka Sho, didn't you? Heheh, 
not bad at all. As last year's winner, 
allow me to congratulate you!

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Sweep-san... Th-Thank you very much. I'm 
honored.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Still, I'm only saying "congratulations" 
for now! I'm not going to just hand over 
today's victory to you, after all.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: The Queen Elizabeth II Cup is mine to—

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: ...Hey now.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Huh? Um... Is something wrong?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Don't "what" me! Uggghhhhh!!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
You've had that sour look on your face 
this whole time! We're about to run a 
race, you know! That's no fun at all!

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: ...? U-Umm—

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Enough already! You must be possessed by 
some kind of furrowed-brow monster, aren't 
you?!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Then that's just perfect. After all, I'm 
the magician of racing!

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: A magic... user...?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
That's right. So I'll show you some magic 
too.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Look forward to it, okay? There's 
absolutely no way you'll be making that 
sour face anymore.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
It's definitely, absolutely gonna be 
thrilling!
